recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future publication review still shows a stale MedicationRequest diagram after regeneration, refresh the generated diagram through the normal build pipeline rather than manually editing the SVG.
issue_request: FHIR-40785 was an Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy change request to add DiagnosticReport as a referenceable reason for MedicationRequest, aligning MedicationRequest with MedicationStatement and MedicationAdministration.
initial_application: Commit c2a83364d3c94784cd196fd4502140b1c347d9af explicitly applied FHIR-40785 by adding http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DiagnosticReport to the MedicationRequest.reason targetProfile list in source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists medicationrequest as an active resource, and the current MedicationRequest.reason target profiles include Condition, Observation, DiagnosticReport, Procedure, and AllergyIntolerance. MedicationStatement.reason and MedicationAdministration.reason also include DiagnosticReport. The checked-in source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest.svg diagram still appears to show only Condition and Observation, but that is a generated-looking diagram artifact rather than the authoritative conformance source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active XML source already implements the Jira decision and hand-editing only the stale-looking SVG would not be an authoritative source fix.
